newsitem.title: USA: Northwestern likely to close Texas plant.
newsitem.headline: Northwestern likely to close Texas plant.

text.p: Northwestern Steel and Wire Co on Thursday said it would most likely close its unprofitable Houston plant.
If the plant is closed permanantly, the company expects to take a pretax, mostly non-cash exit charge estimated at between $95 million and $105 million in the quarter ending July 31.
The company said itagreed to cooperate with the United Steelworkers of America union over the next 30 days to undertake an additional analysis of whether operations could continue at the plant.
